purpose: Teach: フラメンコ/イケメン/ハングル/ヒップ/ヒーリング/ショパン/アキバ/レッズ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、フラメンコ部見学したな
lines.en: So you went to watch the flamenco club, huh?
lines.style: Teasing lilt on the opening. Knowing smirk in the voice. Quick tempo, no real malice — the affectionate needling of someone who's caught you doing something unexpected.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、クラスでイケメンランキング載ったろ?桜
lines.en: You made the 'hottest guys in class' ranking, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Counter-tease, equally swift. Defensive humor — deflecting by turning the mirror back. Lightweight, almost laughing at himself, but there's a real barb underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ハングルの漫画読んでたな
lines.en: You were reading Korean manga the other day.
lines.style: Softer observation now. Genuine curiosity breaking through the banter. Slower pace — she's actually interested, not just needling. Slight lift of intrigue at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ヒップホップダンスサークル入ったろ?桜
lines.en: You joined the hip-hop dance circle, didn't you?
lines.style: Matching her shift in tone. Less defensive. Still teasing but with actual interest beneath it. Slower, more genuine. Testing whether she's really committed to this.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ヒーリングのアプリ使ってたな
lines.en: So you've been using that meditation app.
lines.style: Wry affection returning. Gentle mockery about the vulnerability of needing help to relax. Warm underneath the dig — noticing he takes care of himself matters to her.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、音楽でショパン弾いてたな、桜
lines.en: You're playing Chopin in music class, aren't you?
lines.style: Real admiration now. Respect in the voice — slower, genuine. No defensiveness. Simple statement of fact delivered with quiet sincerity. He means it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、アキバのメイドカフェ憧れてたな
lines.en: And here I thought you were all about that Akiba maid cafe fantasy.
lines.style: Dry wit returning. Exaggerated resignation, like she's giving up on ever fully understanding him. Amused shake in the tone. Affectionate mockery at full strength.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、レッズのユニフォーム着てたな、桜
lines.en: You wore the Reds uniform that time, remember, Sakura?
lines.style: Close and intimate. Softer attack. Tender recollection — bringing up something that matters, something shared. Not teasing anymore. This is the real moment beneath all the banter.
